value.message: Perform a system clone to copy a production instance to a non-production instance prior to your upgrade. Configure your source and target instance by selecting Request clone. Ensure to notify users and stakeholders of your scheduled clone times to properly freeze development, allowing users to close out update sets or backup update sets.
Before starting the clone, remember to back up your update sets to ensure all changes are preserved and can be restored if needed.

It is recommended to clone your production instance to your non-production instance prior to upgrade testing. You will then have a non-prod that closely resembles prod and your tests will be more representative.
Initiate the clone process by visiting the Clone Admin Console to configure your clone start time, source instance and target instance.
